To perform an asynchronous search, send HTTP requests to _plugins/_asynchronous_search
using the following format:
POST opensearch-domain/_plugins/_asynchronous_search
Note
If you're using Elasticsearch 7.10 instead of an OpenSearch version, replace _plugins with
_opendistro in all asynchronous search requests.
You can specify the following asynchronous search options:
